zh-CN.title: 道安
zh-CN.subtitle: 译经制度、僧团组织与东晋佛教网络的关键人物
zh-CN.shortSummary: 道安把佛教译经、僧团规范与区域流动连接起来，是理解襄阳—长安传播网络的重要入口。
curatorialDescription: 本条把道安的译经组织和僧团规范放入东晋城市与交通网络，不把后世宗派谱系直接回写成单一师承事实。
襄阳与长安分别作为活动和译经制度的城市尺度锚点；地图点位不等同于逐日行迹。
zh-CN.researchNote: 道安与慧远、鸠摩罗什的网络关系仍需按传记、书信和译场记录分层核对；当前使用保守的活动区间。

en.title: Dao'an
en.subtitle: A key figure in translation institutions, monastic organisation and the Eastern Jin Buddhist network
en.shortSummary: Dao'an connects Buddhist translation, monastic rules and regional movement, offering an entry into the Xiangyang–Chang'an transmission network.
curatorialDescription: The record places Dao'an's translation organisation and monastic discipline within Eastern Jin urban and travel networks without projecting later school genealogies back into one simple lineage claim.
Xiangyang and Chang'an are city-scale anchors for activity and translation institutions; the map does not claim a day-by-day itinerary.
en.researchNote: Dao'an's network with Huiyuan and Kumarajiva requires layered checking across biographies, letters and translation records; this release uses a conservative activity range.

relation.en: Anchor for activity and monastic networks

zh-CN.title: 慧远
zh-CN.subtitle: 庐山东林寺、僧团组织与中国佛教地方化的入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 慧远在庐山组织东林寺僧团，把山地文化景观、僧团制度与佛教跨区域交流连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 庐山既是现实山地也是制度与记忆叠加的文化景观；本条把慧远的东林寺活动与后世净土叙事分层。
慧远与鸠摩罗什的关系在本版以同时代交流和思想网络呈现，不断言二人有未被来源支持的直接会面。
zh-CN.researchNote: 东林寺创建年代与慧远活动有遗产和传记入口；僧团规模、书信往来与后世净土地位仍需逐条细化。

en.title: Huiyuan
en.subtitle: A gateway into Mount Lu, Donglin Monastery and the localisation of Chinese Buddhism
en.shortSummary: Huiyuan organised the Donglin community at Mount Lu, connecting a mountain cultural landscape with monastic institutions and transregional Buddhist exchange.
curatorialDescription: Mount Lu is both a real landscape and a layered institutional-memory site; Huiyuan's Donglin activity is kept distinct from later Pure Land narratives.
Huiyuan's relation to Kumarajiva is modelled as contemporary exchange and an intellectual network, without claiming an unsupported direct meeting.
en.researchNote: Donglin's foundation and Huiyuan's activity have heritage and biographical entry points; community scale, correspondence and later Pure Land status require further separation.

zh-CN.title: 陶弘景
zh-CN.subtitle: 茅山隐居、道教知识与南朝宫廷咨询的交汇人物
zh-CN.shortSummary: 陶弘景把茅山山地、道教知识生产与梁武帝的宫廷咨询连接起来，是观察宗教与政治互动的关键节点。
curatorialDescription: 本条把陶弘景的隐居、著述和宫廷咨询分成不同关系；‘山中宰相’作为后世称谓不替代具体史料。
茅山是主要空间锚点，建康只表达与梁廷的区域和制度联系。
zh-CN.researchNote: 陶弘景与梁武帝的书信和咨询往来有文本入口；具体居止、术数实践和后世仙传仍需单独审核。

en.title: Tao Hongjing
en.subtitle: Mount Mao reclusion, Daoist knowledge and court consultation in the Southern Dynasties
en.shortSummary: Tao Hongjing connects the Mount Mao landscape, Daoist knowledge production and Liang Wudi's court consultations, making him a key node for religion–politics interaction.
curatorialDescription: The record separates Tao Hongjing's reclusion, writings and court consultation; the later title ‘mountain premier’ does not replace specific historical evidence.
Mount Mao is the primary spatial anchor, while Jiankang records a regional and institutional connection with the Liang court.
en.researchNote: Letters and consultation records provide an entry into Tao Hongjing's relation with Liang Wudi; residences, technical practice and later immortal biographies require separate review.

relation.zh-CN: 宫廷咨询与同时代联系

zh-CN.title: 梁武帝（萧衍）
zh-CN.subtitle: 南朝宫廷佛教、制度赞助与三教交涉的统治者
zh-CN.shortSummary: 梁武帝把建康宫廷、佛教制度化赞助与道教知识咨询置于同一政治空间。
curatorialDescription: 本条呈现皇帝的制度赞助与宗教政策，不把后世‘菩萨皇帝’称号当作未经区分的个人信仰事实。
陶弘景关系以书信与咨询往来表达；人物之间保持时间和身份层次。
zh-CN.researchNote: 梁代寺院制度、宫廷仪式与三教互动需要继续接入正史、碑刻和制度史材料。

en.title: Liang Wudi (Xiao Yan)
en.subtitle: A ruler of court Buddhism, institutional patronage and Three Teachings negotiation
en.shortSummary: Liang Wudi places the Jiankang court, institutional Buddhist patronage and Daoist consultation in one political space.
curatorialDescription: The record presents imperial patronage and religious policy without treating the later title ‘Bodhisattva Emperor’ as an undifferentiated statement of personal belief.
The Tao Hongjing relation is expressed through letters and consultation, while temporal and identity layers remain separate.
en.researchNote: Liang institutional Buddhism, court ritual and Three Teachings interaction require further work with histories, inscriptions and institutional sources.

zh-CN.title: 一行（张遂）
zh-CN.subtitle: 长安译经、天文计算与国家历法工程的交汇人物
zh-CN.shortSummary: 一行把佛教僧侣身份、长安知识网络和大衍历编纂连接起来，显示宗教人物如何进入国家技术制度。
curatorialDescription: 本条把一行的佛教身份、天文计算和历法制度分层；地图只保留长安的制度锚点，不虚构完整行程。
一行与司马承祯在本版作为同时代人物并列，不暗示二人有直接会面。
zh-CN.researchNote: 一行的历法、天文观测和译经活动需继续按《旧唐书》、历志和佛教传记拆分。

en.title: Yixing (Zhang Sui)
en.subtitle: A figure at the intersection of Chang'an translation, astronomy and state calendrical work
en.shortSummary: Yixing connects Buddhist monastic identity, Chang'an knowledge networks and the Dayan calendar, showing how a religious figure entered state technical institutions.
curatorialDescription: The record separates Yixing's Buddhist identity, astronomical calculation and calendrical institution; the map retains Chang'an as an institutional anchor without inventing a complete itinerary.
Yixing and Sima Chengzhen are presented as contemporaries, not as evidence of an unverified direct meeting.
en.researchNote: Yixing's calendar, observations and translation activity require separation across the Old Tang History, calendrical records and Buddhist biographies.

zh-CN.title: 朱熹
zh-CN.subtitle: 白鹿洞书院、理学解释与儒家经典化的后世节点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 朱熹把庐山书院、经典解释与宋代理学组织起来，是观察儒家传统如何重返历史空间的重要人物。
curatorialDescription: 朱熹与慧远相隔数百年，本馆以同一庐山文化景观中的比较关系呈现，不把二人并置误写为同时代交往。
白鹿洞书院是制度与教育空间；人物影响关系指向后世儒家经典化，不替代朱熹自身文本。
zh-CN.researchNote: 朱熹生平、书院复兴和理学文本已有较多入口；庐山与武夷山的具体活动节点仍需接入版本和地方志资料。

en.title: Zhu Xi
en.subtitle: White Deer Grotto Academy, Neo-Confucian interpretation and a later node of Confucian canonisation
en.shortSummary: Zhu Xi connects the Mount Lu academy landscape, classical interpretation and Song Neo-Confucian learning, offering a later historical-space entry into the Confucian tradition.
curatorialDescription: Zhu Xi lived centuries after Huiyuan; the museum uses a comparative relation within the same Mount Lu cultural landscape without implying contemporary contact.
The White Deer Grotto Academy is an institutional and educational space; reception relations point to later Confucian canonisation rather than replacing Zhu Xi's own texts.
en.researchNote: Zhu Xi's life, academy revival and Neo-Confucian texts have substantial entry points; specific Mount Lu and Wuyi activity nodes still require editions and local records.
